generations.prompt:
Create a production game HEAD SPRITE ATLAS, copying the VISUAL MATERIAL and CHARACTER DESIGN of the attached hard-cut photographic specimen collage extremely faithfully. The attached study is a style reference only: create ONLY SIX floating photographic human-hybrid HEAD cutouts, NOT full bodies, scenes or a board.

OUTPUT: landscape 1536x1024 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six invisible 512x512 cells, one entire head wholly inside each cell. Centers are (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768). Every head INCLUDING ears/horns/hair must have at least 45 pixels transparent margin on every side of its cell. All six heads appear about 350px high, not big filling the cell. No object ever crosses a cell edge. NO visible grid, checkerboard, green/cream background, frame, labels or text. Nothing exterior but transparency. Only head and a tiny bare neck taper, absolutely NO torso or neck clothing.

STYLE EXACTLY AS REFERENCE: actual PHOTOGRAPHIC human faces assembled with real photographic animal fragments by clean hard SCISSOR CUTTING. Faces have real skin pores, fine wrinkles, real photographic irises, fine real hair strands, natural photographic lighting, realistically proportioned adult noses and lips. Real animal fur/ear/horn photographs splice into human faces. Hard smooth cut silhouettes with a very thin pale cream cut edge like the reference. This is surreal assemblage of found colour photographs, NOT drawn paper, NOT angular collaged skin facets, NOT painted/illustrated faces, NOT marker, NOT fibrous scraps, NOT geometric art, NOT CGI rendering. Bleak poor working adults, naturally tired and solemn. Almost everyone is part beast, but ALL faces must retain mostly mature HUMAN facial eyes, brows, cheek structure and expression, never complete animal heads. No children or cute mascots.

TOP LEFT CELL: LADY SUPINE, copy the beautiful adult brunette woman face from the reference's top-left enormous head. The same softly wavy short brunette bob, pale realistic freckled skin, large clear grey-green almond eyes and naturally rosy restrained lips. HEAD ONLY, no yellow clothes or glove. A large clean black OPEN-TOP OVAL ELLIPSE occupies the uncovered top of her head, just above her forehead, with a thin believable pale rim as in reference. The ellipse is a non-graphic surreal photo-assembly with black paper insert, no injury, no blood, no wound. Clearly an uncapped head, NOT a crown, hat or painted mark. Both eyes clearly visible. Beautiful AND terrifying through serene stillness and giant hollow head. Copy this face's real photographic quality very closely.

TOP MIDDLE CELL: ADA the adult working hare-human woman from the reference's blue-coat seated woman. Head only: exhausted compassionate adult face, short scruffy brown curls, naturally pale weathered skin, mature green-grey eyes, two REAL PHOTOGRAPHIC hare ears on top with soft brown grey fur. No blue coat or neck scarf. Make her unmistakably human with hare ears, not an animal face.

TOP RIGHT CELL: ARISTOBAT the adult male bat-human from reference beige coat man. Head only: thin gaunt weathered adult HUMAN man's face, deep tired eyes, dark short hair, real brown bat ears rising each side of head, integrated photographic bat-ear fragments. NO wings, no beige clothes. Stern ordinary exhausted bureaucrat with bat anatomy, not a monstrous animal skull.

BOTTOM LEFT CELL: HUMAN PLAYER, disheveled poor ADULT MAN, about 30–40, tired warm brown eyes, real olive skin with small blemishes, scruffy dark hair and faint uneven stubble. Fully HUMAN, no animal parts. Serious worn dignity and tentative expression. Bare head only.

BOTTOM RIGHT CELL: OX-HUMAN ADULT MAN, about 55, broad mature real human face, deeply tired brown eyes, weathered tan skin, short greying brown hair, integrate real small rounded ox ears and two short compact worn horns, slight ox-like broad nose blending into human face. Inside is a REAL COLOR photographic beautiful elegant ADULT human woman's head and a yellow-gloved hand blowing a kiss. She is the same beautiful Lady Supine of the supplied reference: clear grey-green eyes, subtle freckles, natural brown hair and graceful adult lips; her enormous real head has a huge oval OPEN HOLE IN ITS TOP with a clean dark-black hollow and fine exposed rim, exactly the reference's disturbing open-topped head silhouette. Entire circular billboard and feet fit inside its cell.

Carefully preserve all six isolated silhouettes and each cell's empty transparent margins. Transparent background means alpha=0 outside every object, not a color-painted background.
